Privacy read routes require privacy:read; subject erasure and retention mutations require privacy:write and idempotency keys.
feature authz manifest maps api_surface operations to route permissions or explicit public rationales.
Subject erasure emits privacy.subject.erased and retention enforcement emits privacy.retention.enforced; the event ledger maps those audit events to F79.
Data-subject export and catalog reads are read-only and guarded by privacy:read.
served HTTP entrypoints are covered by normalized request metrics and tracing without tenant/secret labels; retention worker counters expose run, row, failure, and last-success signals.

feature-specific a11y receipt: Privacy and data-subject controls is mapped to route-backed GUI workflow evidence and exercised by web/src/__tests__/feature_a11y_receipts.test.tsx, which renders the registered route surface, runs axe, and verifies keyboard focus reaches the workflow.
visible UI strings are extracted into the typed message catalog and checked by npm run i18n:check.
